notes.title: Event Announcement: "gamescom 2024"
notes.notes:
Hello!

We will be exhibiting at the game event "gamescom 2024," which will be held in Germany this August. It is Europe's largest game event, running for five days.

CUBEN will be showcased at the Ukiyo Studios booth.
Hall 10.1 Booth A.080

We’re excited to meet players from all around the world!
